title: Revelation of the Echelon surveillance system
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Revelation of the Echelon surveillance system, about unspecified (1990s) at Australia / Five Eyes, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of the biggest stories I did in my time in Australia was I revealed the existence exclusively of the Echelon communications surveillance system,

plain: An Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, says that one of the biggest stories of his career in Australia, in the 1990s, was his exclusive report revealing Echelon, a secret communications surveillance system. He tells it to show that he has exposed hidden government programmes before, which matters for his reporting on UFOs.
